requirements.general: Any one of these: Pass SPM with minimum (3) C / Credits including Mathematics and a Pass in English and Drawing subject and (2) other subjects. Drawing test/portfolio needed if without pass in art subject at SPM level or without drawing subject at SPM level. O-Level: With Grade C in (3) subjects including Mathematics and Drawing subject or (2) other subjects. UEC: For senior middle three (SM3) only. Pass UEC with Grade B in (3) subjects including Mathematics and (2) other subjects. Certificate (Polytechnic): Minimum CGPA of 2.50 and pass C in (2) subjects including Mathematics and a pass in SPM English and (1) other subject. Drawing test/portfolio needed if without pass in Art subject at SPM Level or without Drawing subject at SPM Level. Certificate (KKM): Minimum CGPA of 2.75 with 2Cs (including Mathematics) and a pass in SPM English. Certificate/SKM III: Minimum CGPA of 2.50 with a C in SPM, pass in Mathematics and Drawing test by MAHSA University SAM/Tertiary Entrance Rank (TER)/UAI: Average of 50% or higher in 5 subjects (including Drawing and English) CPU/CIMP: Average of 50% or higher in 6 subjects (including Drawing and English) HSC/AUSMAT: Average of 50% or higher in 5 subjects (including Drawing and English) SKM - Pass in Certificate / SKM Level 3 with minimum CGPA 2.50 with Grade C at SPM Level and Pass Mathematics Vocational & Technical Qualification - Pass in certificate/college professional Mara (KKM) with minimum CGPA of 2.75 and Pass C including Mathematics and 1 subject as well as Pass in English at SPM Level and 1 other subject. Other Qualifications - Other equivalent to SPM qualification as recognized by SENATE of University English Language Requirements: IELTS: 5.0 or TOEFL PBT: 500 or MUET: Band 3
